lead: `python tools/try.py` runs a case's `--FILE--` and drops its `--ARGS--`.
body: A `#[Command]` case therefore prints the usage page and exits 2 under `try.py` while passing under the real runner, which reads as the case being wrong. `target/debug/nvs.exe test <case>.nvst` runs one case with every section honoured and is the binary the driver's acceptance check uses, so it is the answer for any case with `--ARGS--`, `--ENV--`, `--INI--` or `--RUN--`.
